scoring_guide.title: How SP investment scoring works
scoring_guide.intro: Point-sum suggestion list for SP/SSP investment (creator criteria v2 + datamine upgrades). Not a damage calculator. Filter by tag or Eternal Road Expert stage to spot clear shortlist winners.
overrides: MS bands, weapon tiers, MOV/range 6, and letter cutoffs synced to the creator’s criteria sheet.
MAP ammo only (1 → +1; 2+ → +2); flat mapweapon is not stacked.
Best non-MAP weapon bonus typed: Crit / High HP / High·Low range / High MP / Reduce Def (+1); Low HP = 0. Applies on SP and SSP.
High-value tags (limited niche / supporter-relevant) can add up to +2 beyond tag-count bands.
GN Field / Positron Reflector passives award no ability points.
Reborns Gundam uses transformed-form stats when scoring.
gaps: Ability / linked-pilot quality remain heuristic (improved regex + effect families).
Tag weights are a curated allowlist, not full supporter-rarity analysis.
Debuff “level” 3–6 is mapped from DEF-debuff % bands.
Pilot scoring still uses public How it works tables (no creator pilot sheet).
Pilot recommend-MS points use this list's unit letters (SP/SSP best).
